task.title: Validate node affinity behavior with kubectl and scheduler events
task.shortdesc: Confirm that node affinity rules are applied as expected by checking placement decisions and scheduler diagnostics.

step.cmd: Deploy a test pod with explicit node affinity rules that represent your intended constraints.
Use "kubectl get pod -o wide" to record the selected node and compare it against expected labels.
Run "kubectl describe pod" to review scheduling events and confirm which predicates were applied.
List matching nodes with label selectors (for example, "kubectl get nodes -l key=value") to validate candidate sets.
Iterate on affinity rules and re-apply until placement consistently matches policy under normal cluster load.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
